title: LayerStatsDocument
description: Parser crosscheck statistics for one working DXF (ADR-0002 6). `stats.ts` in the viewer and `stats.py` in the engine emit this same document from the same bytes; the crosscheck compares them bucket by bucket and paints each layer green / amber / red. Tolerances live in the comparer, not here: counts must match exactly, lengths within 0.1 percent, areas within 0.5 percent (docs/PLAN.md 5).

buckets.description: One entry per (layer, space) pair that holds at least one entity. Ordered by `layer` then `space` so two documents can be diffed textually.

totals.description: Document totals across every layer and space.

count_by_type.title: CountByType
count_by_type.description: Entity count per normalised entity type. Types with a zero count are omitted.

insert_by_block.title: InsertByBlock
insert_by_block.description: INSERT count per block name. Block names are NFC normalised.

aggregate.title: StatsAggregate
aggregate.description: The seven crosscheck measures of ADR-0002 6.

length_sum_mm.description: Sum of curve lengths in millimetres. Curves are measured on the flattened approximation at the 0.1mm index tolerance so both parsers agree.

hatch_area_sum_mm2.description: Sum of net HATCH areas in square millimetres.

text_count.description: Number of TEXT, MTEXT, ATTRIB and ATTDEF entities counted.
